tab.title: Proxmox Power
tab.intro: Start a saved VM or container, or monitor one already running. Automatic shutdown uses five low CPU checks after 10 minutes, or the uptime limit you set.
tab.outdated: Termix is still running an older plugin backend. Restart the Termix server to load this update.

webhooks.title: Webhook integrations
webhooks.auth: Automation services can control guests through the authenticated Termix API. Create a Termix API key for a user with Proxmox Power manage permission, then configure your service to send JSON POST requests.
webhooks.routes: Start a guest: POST /plugin-api/pve-power/start with that guest’s config from GET /plugin-api/pve-power/vm. Stop a guest gracefully: POST /plugin-api/pve-power/stop with { "key": "<guest key>" } from the same response.
webhooks.headers: Send Authorization: Bearer <Termix API key> and Content-Type: application/json. These routes require Termix authentication; this plugin does not expose a public unauthenticated webhook URL.
